description: Repairs r-fmt-1/create-accdb-decimal and r-fmt-1/read-accdb-decimal: DAO DDL refused DECIMAL(18,4) with 3292, so T was never created and both records hold only system tables. Asks, on a new ACCDB database from DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128) kept as a fixture: ADO (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0) creates T(ID INTEGER primary key, V DECIMAL(18,4)) in the closed file; DAO then writes a Null row (ID 1) and the values 12345678901234.5678, -0.0001, 1.5 and 7 as SQL numeric literals (IDs 2 to 5), and through a table-type recordset AddNew/Value/Update VT_CY 1.5, VT_I4 7 and the BSTR integer text 7 (IDs 6 to 8), with DBEngine.Errors read after each put and update. Reads V's Type, Size, Attributes and property list (Precision and Scale where present), the rows through a TableDef snapshot and through SQL with CStr(V); closes, keeps the file, reopens it read-only and reads the same user-table view again. No system table is opened.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
